## About Me

Strategic Management major at the BYU Marriott School of Business with experience in both established and startup environments. At Podium and Driven I contributed to projects that required adaptability, analytical thinking, and a strong attention to detail. I also bring direct experience from building custom 3D props for businesses, blending creativity with execution.

I am motivated by opportunities to solve complex problems, apply data-driven insights, and help organizations grow. Known for working efficiently and keeping projects on track, I combine strategic thinking with practical execution to deliver results.
